# TheEduAssist

> TheEduAssist is an enterprise e-learning design agency and technical learning consultancy helping organizations, SaaS companies, corporate training teams, academies, and course creators design, build, migrate, and optimize digital learning experiences.

## Primary Hubs & Inquiries

- [Home](https://www.theeduassist.com/): Enterprise instructional design and digital learning architecture.
- [Services Hub](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/): Comprehensive e-learning development, migration, and learning technology services.
- [Free Architecture Audit](https://www.theeduassist.com/book-free-audit/): Zero-obligation 24–48 hour technical audit of LMS infrastructure, SCORM packages, and WCAG accessibility.
- [Knowledge Hub (Resources)](https://www.theeduassist.com/resources/): In-depth technical guides, checklists, and compliance frameworks for modern learning systems.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.theeduassist.com/enterprise-solutions/): Scaled learning infrastructure for enterprise workforces.
- [Kajabi Platform Services](https://www.theeduassist.com/kajabi-services/): Custom Kajabi course builds, webinar funnels, and checkout optimization.
- [Case Studies](https://www.theeduassist.com/case-studies/): Verified client implementations, migrations, and measurable learning ROI.
- [Pricing](https://www.theeduassist.com/pricing/): Transparent scoping for custom course development and LMS engineering.
- [Technical Blog](https://www.theeduassist.com/blog/): Actionable analysis on instructional design, LMS migrations, xAPI, and learning technology.
- [Contact Us](https://www.theeduassist.com/contact-us/): Direct consultation and project intake.

## Core Services & Capabilities

- [Instructional Design Services](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/instructional-design/): ADDIE, backward design, and scenario-based workplace learning.
- [LMS Implementation & Migration](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/lms-implementation-migration/): Zero-downtime LMS migrations, SCORM/xAPI transfer, and database migration.
- [Custom eLearning Development](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/custom-elearning-development/): Interactive Articulate 360, Rise, Captivate, and HTML5 courses.
- [Course Localization & Translation](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/course-localization-translation/): Multi-language e-learning adaptation, RTL support, and cultural validation.
- [AI-Powered eLearning Development](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/ai-powered-elearning/): AI tutors, adaptive learning pathways, and automated knowledge checks.
- [AI Ethics & Corporate Training](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/ai-ethics-corporate-training/): Enterprise governance, compliance, and responsible AI training.
- [Quality Assurance & Compliance](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/quality-assurance/): Section 508, WCAG 2.2 AA validation, and cross-browser LMS testing.
- [Assessment Design](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/assessment-design/): Psychometrically validated quizzes, diagnostic assessments, and certification pathways.
- [Content Conversion](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/content-conversion/): Legacy PPT, PDF, and video conversion into modern interactive SCORM/cmi5 modules.
- [Funnels & Automation](https://www.theeduassist.com/services/funnels-automation/): Learner onboarding automation, CRM integrations, and high-ticket education funnels.

## Knowledge Hub Guides

- [eLearning Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)](https://www.theeduassist.com/resources/accessibility/elearning-accessibility-wcag/): Technical standards, screen reader compatibility, and contrast compliance.
- [eLearning Localization Checklist](https://www.theeduassist.com/resources/localization/elearning-localization-checklist/): End-to-end framework for global multilingual course rollouts.
- [SaaS Customer Onboarding & Training](https://www.theeduassist.com/resources/saas-training/saas-customer-onboarding/): Curriculum frameworks to accelerate product adoption and reduce churn.
- [Customer Education Strategy Guide](https://www.theeduassist.com/resources/customer-education/customer-education-strategy/): Scaling academy programs from pilot to enterprise maturity.
- [Building an Enterprise Knowledge Base](https://www.theeduassist.com/resources/knowledge-bases/how-to-build-a-knowledge-base/): Information architecture, taxonomy design, and self-service search optimization.

## Trust & Governance Architecture

- [Trust Centre Overview](https://www.theeduassist.com/trust-centre/): Quality standards, data security, and procurement readiness.
- [Security & Data Privacy](https://www.theeduassist.com/trust-centre/security-privacy/): Learner data protection, SOC 2 compliance, and GDPR alignment.
- [Accessibility Commitment](https://www.theeduassist.com/trust-centre/accessibility/): Conformance with WCAG 2.2 AA and international accessibility standards.
- [Responsible AI Principles](https://www.theeduassist.com/trust-centre/responsible-ai/): Algorithmic transparency, human oversight, and data provenance in learning AI.
- [Delivery Methodology](https://www.theeduassist.com/trust-centre/delivery-methodology/): Phased milestones, quality gates, and enterprise QA governance.
- [Procurement & Vendor Readiness](https://www.theeduassist.com/trust-centre/procurement/): Enterprise procurement checklist, MSA terms, and security questionnaires.
